title: FDA Appendix G steps 2 and 3: the linearized criterion and the two conditions
subject: reference-scaled average BE criterion

rule.hypotheses: H0: (mu_T - mu_R)^2 / sigma_WR^2 >= theta  versus  Ha: < theta
rule.quantity: the 95% upper confidence bound for (mu_T - mu_R)^2 - theta*sigma_WR^2
rule.method: Howe's Approximation I (Howe 1974, J Am Stat Assoc 69(347):789-794), as cited in the guidance footnote

sas_lines.note: cinv is SAS's inverse CDF, so cinv(0.95, df) is the 95th PERCENTILE of the chi-square distribution - not an upper-tail quantile. scipy's equivalent is stats.chi2.ppf(0.95, df), NOT stats.chi2.isf(0.95, df).

degrees_of_freedom.which: dfd is the degrees of freedom of the REFERENCE VARIANCE model (dlat), not of the treatment contrast (ilat)
degrees_of_freedom.partial_replicate: from PROC GLM overallanova on dlat = seq: the error degrees of freedom, n_D - 3
degrees_of_freedom.fully_replicate: from the Estimates output of PROC MIXED on dlat = seq, which for a single residual variance component is n_D - 2
degrees_of_freedom.why_it_matters: The two models are fitted on different subject sets whenever a subject is missing its test measurement, so a single shared degrees-of-freedom field would be wrong for one of them.

expected.assertion: bound_y is closer to zero than y
expected.why: y is negative and df/chisq_0.95(df) < 1, so bound_y > y. It is an upper bound on -theta*sigma_WR^2, hence a LOWER bound on the reference variance - less scaling, a harder criterion. The opposite tail would scale more generously than FDA.

expected.assertion: x subtracts the squared standard error
expected.why: Dropping it biases the criterion toward failing, by the sampling variance of the estimate, most in the smallest studies.

expected.assertion: bound_x squares the LARGER ABSOLUTE confidence limit
expected.why: For an interval straddling zero, the larger absolute limit is not the upper one.

A.statement: The 95% upper confidence bound for (mu_T - mu_R)^2 - theta*sigma_WR^2 must be <= 0

B.statement: The point estimate of the T/R geometric mean ratio must fall within [0.8000, 1.2500]

conjunction.statement: For T to be bioequivalent to R, BOTH of the following conditions must be satisfied for each PK parameter tested
conjunction.why_recorded: Criterion B is the stop on reference scaling, which otherwise widens the acceptance region without limit as reference variability grows. It is the criterion most likely to be dropped, because A is the elaborate one and looks like the answer.

treatment_contrast.partial_replicate: PROC GLM, model ilat = seq, estimate 'average' intercept 1 seq 0.3333333333 0.3333333333 0.3333333333
treatment_contrast.fully_replicate: PROC MIXED, model ilat = seq / ddfm=satterth, estimate 'average' intercept 1 seq 0.5 0.5
treatment_contrast.weights: EQUAL ON THE SEQUENCE MEANS, not on subjects. With unequal sequence sizes the two differ, and dropouts make sequences unequal in almost every real study.

endpoint_scope.statement: Step 1 determines the method 'for the individual PK parameter(s)', and III.C carries the analysis out 'for both AUC and Cmax'.
endpoint_scope.consequence: AUC and Cmax may take different methods in one study. A study-level classification on the worst endpoint would give the better-behaved endpoint a scaled acceptance region it has not earned.

source.section: Appendix G (highly variable drugs), steps 2 and 3, and the SAS examples
source.verified_by: primary document, read at the cited section
source.limitation: The guidance states the algorithm, the constants and the SAS route, and contains no worked dataset - no input values and no published answer. So this closes tier 1A for the criterion and cannot close tier 1B, which needs a regulator's number to reproduce. No external numerical oracle has been run either: PowerTOST would be a tier-3 cross-check and R is not available in this environment.

covers: The criterion arithmetic, the two conditions and their conjunction, the chi-square direction, and which degrees of freedom scale which term. It asserts nothing about FDA NTI (Appendix F) or EMA ABEL, neither of which is implemented.
